rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: The State Duma's statement, adopted by resolution 3961-II (signed by Duma Chairman Г.Н.Селезнев, Moscow, 12 May 1999), says that President Б.Н.Ельцин decided on 12 May 1999, without prior consultation with the Federal Assembly, to dismiss the Government of the Russian Federation headed by Е.М.Примаков; it calls the dismissal unfounded and proposes that the President resign early.
rows.locator: Resolution points 1-3 (adopts the statement; sends it to Rossiyskaya Gazeta for publication; in force on adoption) and signature block; annexed statement, first, fourth and last paragraphs
